key: Bellossom says:\n"Oddish has been wrapped within darkness, but Vileplume yet speaks only the truth."
en: Bellossom says:\n"Oddish has been wrapped within darkness, but Vileplume yet speaks only the truth."
ja: キレイハナが言う:\n「ナゾノクサは闇に包まれているが、ラフレシアはなお真実のみを語る」
キレイハナは光か闇か?

key: Oddish says:\n"Gloom speaks nothing but lies, however Bellossom is pure as light."
en: Oddish says:\n"Gloom speaks nothing but lies, however Bellossom is pure as light."
ja: ナゾノクサが言う:\n「クサイハナはうそしか言わないが、キレイハナは光のように純粋だ」
ナゾノクサは光か闇か?

key: Gloom says:\n"Oddish is young and innocent, but Vileplume knows nothing but deceit."
en: Gloom says:\n"Oddish is young and innocent, but Vileplume knows nothing but deceit."
ja: クサイハナが言う:\n「ナゾノクサは幼くむくだが、ラフレシアはぎまんしか知らない」
クサイハナは光か闇か?

key: Gloom says:\n"Oddish and Vileplume are both ripe with darkness."
en: Gloom says:\n"Oddish and Vileplume are both ripe with darkness."
ja: クサイハナが言う:\n「ナゾノクサとラフレシアは、どちらも闇に満ちている」

key: Vileplume says:\n"Bellossom strayed far from the path of light, but Gloom remains truthful as ever."
en: Vileplume says:\n"Bellossom strayed far from the path of light, but Gloom remains truthful as ever."
ja: ラフレシアが言う:\n「キレイハナは光の道から大きく外れたが、クサイハナは相変わらず正直だ」
ラフレシアは光か闇か?
リン: 誰もが知る一つのこと――
絶対的な権力は、絶対的に腐敗する。

key: Any man who thinks himself exempt to this is his own example to its truth.
en: Any man who thinks himself exempt to this is his own example to its truth.
ja: 自分だけはそれと無縁だと思う者は、そのこと自体が真実の証明となる。
心の奥底では、皆が闇である。
よく覚えておくといい。
